capabilities: Pull repository changes from a ribbon button
Stage, commit and push changes with an automated message
Show commit history in an in-app tab
Configure device name and commit message prefix
Register git actions as commands and hotkeys
extras: The README notes the plugin has not been reviewed by Obsidian. Commits are automated with a message like "Vault sync: mac 2026-07-28 14:30:00".
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to run git pull, commit and push or inspect commit history without leaving the app or opening a terminal.
summary: Git integration that adds ribbon icons and commands to pull, commit and push vault changes, and view commit history in a tab.
